purpose: Calibration set for the LLM judge that decides whether a predicted item (a) and a gold item (b) in the same field express the same fact.

labels.equivalent: Same fact. Wording, punctuation, case, boilerplate implied by the field ('do not use', 'ask a doctor if'), unit conversions and medical synonyms do not matter.
labels.partial: Same topic but one side is broader, narrower, or is one item of a list on the other side.
labels.not_equivalent: Different fact: different item, number, severity, scope of substance, polarity, or strength (caution vs prohibition).

rules: Always read a and b in the context of the field; the field name supplies the implied action.
Numbers and thresholds must match in value (1 week == 7 days; 4 days != 7 days).
Severity words (minor/serious, blurred/loss) and scope words (bacterial, povidone-) change meaning.
